releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.16.6 - Immediate On-Screen Window Visibility & Fix Premature Handle Allocation:
- Fixed Premature Handle Creation: Removed RegisterHotKey from constructor which was forcing Win32 handle creation before Application.Run, causing WinForms to think the window should be hidden.
- Added OnLoad & OnShown explicit Visibility & BringToFront guarantees.
- System Tray single-click & double-click immediate show/restore.
- Full 6 Google Stitch OLED Neon Precision tabs intact.
